crate-2x4x17.title: Bag Library crate 2x4x17
crate-2x4x17.blurb: Files 70x100 mm component bags upright like a card index (cavity 80x164x114 mm, still cappable and stackable). Thumb window in front, index cards key into the side-wall slots.
crate-2x4x17.material: PETG (PETG-ESD if you also keep unbagged ICs in it)
crate-2x4x17.print_notes: Upright, no supports (window arch bridges fine), 3 walls, 15% infill. Optional 6x2 mm magnets.

cap-2x4.title: Cap 2x4
cap-2x4.blurb: Lid for the Bag Library crate; seats in the stacking lip, label on top.
cap-2x4.print_notes: Upside down (plate on the bed), no supports.

card-2x-res.title: Index card RES (2-wide)
card-2x-res.blurb: Divider card with an embossed RES tab; drops into any side-wall slot of the 2x4x17 crate. Tabs are staggered across 3 positions.
card-2x-res.material: PLA or PETG (contrasting colour swap at the text layer)
card-2x-res.print_notes: Flat, text up, no supports, 100% infill. Pause/colour change at 1.2 mm makes the text pop.

follower-2x.title: Bag follower (2-wide)
follower-2x.blurb: Ribbed wedge that slides behind the last bag so a half-empty row stays upright; lift it out by the top of the front plate.
follower-2x.print_notes: As modelled (base plate on the bed), no supports, 20% infill. Drop a few washers between the ribs if it needs more weight.
